scope: Saved evaluation arithmetic only; no project code imported, no models, optimizers, environments or simulations invoked.

formulas.cost: fsum over 64 epochs and 14 raw component values; no raw cost field used as the estimator
formulas.patient_outcomes: distinct patient_id with final status lost/delivered at epoch63; cross-checked monotone terminal ID sets and raw cumulative/new-loss fields
formulas.pair: match exact block, condition, replicate and seed; verify equal patient-ID cohort across four roles
formulas.aggregation: 12 equally weighted worlds per condition (3 independent blocks x4), 4 equally weighted worlds per block
formulas.action_window: epochs0..47; requested is saved post-clipping request, executed is committed projected hours (not contemporaneous realized applied labor)
formulas.action_thresholds: zero/cap site tolerance1e-7; shared8 and changed-action tolerance1e-6
formulas.hash_aggregate: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 lines: relative_path + NUL + compressed_file_SHA256 + newline

multipliers.note: Training receipt arithmetic only; training raw trajectories were not reread.

reconciliation.bootstrap: Reported interval checked against screen only; algorithm not independently rerun.

limitations: Independent recomputation is not an independent scientific replication.
Three independently trained blocks; four paired worlds per block-condition; synthetic outcomes are not clinical safety evidence.
Evaluation is greedy/frozen after simulation training, not deployment-online adaptation or isolated graph attribution.
Action saturation and multiplier evolution are descriptive associations, not identified causal mechanisms.
Requests were already clipped before logging; pre-clipping affine outputs and gradients are not reconstructed.
No process, terminal, archive, lock or historical-result checks performed.

interpretation.primary_result: No patient-preserving training signal: all three persistent block savings versus fixed are negative, every condition has positive mean extra losses versus fixed, and the reported persistent savings interval is wholly negative.
interpretation.relative_cost_only: Constrained has lower mean cost and fewer losses than cost-only in each condition, but persistent savings are positive in only one of three independent blocks; this does not overcome inferiority to fixed or ID-MPC.
interpretation.patient_outcome_definition: Lost denotes the simulator's terminal lost state, not observed mortality or a calibrated clinical safety endpoint.
interpretation.action_observation: Strong between-block variation; constrained persistent block0 lower-bound site requests 737/768, block1 94/768, block2 0/768. Block2 shared budget binds 184/192 decisions. No neural request reaches site cap4. Logged requested hours are post-clipping.
interpretation.multiplier_observation: 36 scalar receipts reconcile, 32 increases and4 decreases, zero bound contacts, after-values0.8..3.68. The multiplier cap20 did not bind in recorded updates. This does not identify why the approximate training constraint failed.
interpretation.arithmetic_attribution: Persistent constrained-minus-fixed patient_loss_cost +2025000, expiry_cost +1390000, bioreactor_shortage_cost +971956.2666666667, partly offset by reagent_purchase_cost -1588554.0101598052. These are additive ledger differences, not causal mediation.
interpretation.rounding: Maximum comparison difference1.4901161193847656e-8 arises at summation precision; no differences exceed absolute tolerance1e-6 and patient count differences are zero.
